en: In my youth I travelled the whole world as a Pokémon trainer.
These days my only pleasure is watching young trainers battle.
A trainer named Ilse is staying with me today. Would you like to challenge her downstairs?
A trainer named Ronan is staying with me today. Would you like to challenge him downstairs?
A trainer named Wren is staying with me today. Would you like to challenge him downstairs?
Splendid! The old house isn't so sturdy, mind, so keep it to a fair match.
I'll be watching from the stairs. Show me something good!
No? What a shame. I'd so looked forward to watching.
Now and then a visitor comes to battle downstairs. Nobody's come for a while, though.
What a match that was today! Come back tomorrow. Someone else may be staying.
